label: cluster or cocktail ring
construction: A cluster ring: one continuous shank; a group of stones arranged close together on a single metal head (a flower, a dome, or a geometric cluster as specified), every stone seated in prongs or beads that are part of that head, the head joined to the shank.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the ring fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
